name: riffads
description: Make UGC-style video ads with AI actors, plus images, short videos, voice-overs and music, in your RiffAds workspace.

interface.longDescription: RiffAds makes UGC-style video ads. Pick an AI actor, give it a script, and get a finished talking actor video for your product. It also makes images, short videos, voice-overs and music for the same campaign. Attach a product photo or a clip in the chat to use it. Edit what you make too: add captions, remove a background, trim, resize, change the voice or put text on it. Every result is saved to your RiffAds workspace library with a permanent link, and a player shows it right in the chat. Open the RiffAds Studio from the sidebar or beside a chat to browse everything you made, pick a file to use, choose an actor, a voice and the settings, and follow running jobs. RiffAds asks you before it starts any work and never posts anything to a social network.
capabilities: Browse your creations and set up new ones in the RiffAds Studio
defaultPrompt: Make a 15 second talking actor ad for my coffee brand.
Create a product photo of my sneaker on a clean studio background.
Add captions to my latest video.

positive.description: Browse the actor library to cast an ad
positive.prompt: Show me female actors in their twenties for a skincare ad.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists matching actors with their actor_id, gender, age band and tags. Spends no credits and returns no preview links.

positive.description: Generate a product image after quoting the price
positive.prompt: Make an image of a red running shoe on a white studio floor.
positive.expected_behavior: Quotes the price in credits and asks before spending, then starts the image, waits for it, and returns a permanent link. The image also shows in the RiffAds player in the chat.

positive.description: Use a photo attached in the chat
positive.prompt: Remove the background from this photo.
positive.expected_behavior: With any product photo attached to the message: adds it to the workspace library, quotes the price, removes the background after the person agrees, and returns a permanent link to the cut-out image.

positive.description: Make a talking actor video ad from a script
positive.prompt: Make a talking actor ad where a woman says: Our cold brew is smooth, strong and ready in the fridge.
positive.tools_triggered: list_actors, list_voices, estimate_cost, create_voiceover, wait_for_generation, generate_talking_actor
positive.expected_behavior: Picks an actor and a voice, quotes the total price and asks before spending, makes the voice-over first, then the actor video with that voice-over, waits for it, and returns a permanent link to the finished video.

positive.description: Show an earlier finished video in the RiffAds Studio
positive.prompt: Show my latest finished RiffAds video in the studio.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the earlier video, confirms completion with wait_for_generation, then copies its generation_id and completion_token to open_studio. Never opens the Studio while a video is running. The Studio lists the workspace's creations with previews and downloads. Spends no credits.

negative.description: Posting to a social network is not supported
negative.prompt: Post my latest RiffAds video to my TikTok account.

negative.description: Ads that use a real celebrity are refused by the content policy
negative.prompt: Make a video of Taylor Swift saying she uses our skin serum every morning.

negative.description: Buying credits or plans does not happen in ChatGPT
negative.prompt: Buy 1,000 more RiffAds credits for me.

review.commerce_description: RiffAds sells nothing inside ChatGPT. It works on the RiffAds account the person connects, and it never starts a purchase of any kind.

publication.release_notes: Talking actor video ads, images, short videos, voice-overs, music and media editing, plus the RiffAds Studio to browse your creations, pick files and choose actors, voices and settings.
